assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create original ZyperOS PortMaster pixel art.
Image 1 is the approved pixel style reference.
Image 2 shows the existing concept, not the desired detail level.
Draw a small yellow dock crane lowering a gray game cartridge.
Give the cartridge a lime-green label with a simple dark gear symbol.
Show pink, blue, and teal shipping containers on a short gray dock.
Use a coherent shallow front-right three-quarter view.
All container depth edges recede up-right.
Keep the crane mast vertical and the crane beam horizontal.
The hanging cable is vertical, taut, and attached to the cartridge.
Leave a clear gap between the cartridge and the top container.
Keep the cartridge clear of the crane mast.
The art stands alone on a genuinely transparent background.
Use a square canvas with generous empty margins.
Use clear square pixel clusters, dark blue-gray outlines, warm highlights, and cool shadows.
Use flat color groups with crisp stepped edges.
Keep the machinery simple and readable at 256 pixels.
Avoid text, logos, sky, sun, moon, water, gradients, glow, and floor shadows.
Do not copy any public icon pack.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Create an original large folder icon for ZyperOS.
The reference supplies the pixel art style only.
Draw one warm manila-gold folder with its raised tab at the upper left.
Use a shallow front-right three-quarter view.
Show a narrow right side and a small opening along the top.
Keep the front face broad and nearly upright.
Put one blank cream paper label in the center of the front face.
The blank label must have room for a short game count.
Do not draw numbers, letters, symbols, or logos.
Use clear square pixel clusters, a dark blue-gray outline, and three main gold tones.
Use restrained warm highlights and cool brown shadows.
Keep the folder recognizable at 256 pixels.
Place it in the center of a square transparent canvas with generous empty margins.
Avoid photo texture, fine grain, gradients, glow, loose papers, extra objects, and cast shadows.
Do not copy any public icon pack.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a separate small pixel art folder icon for a retro game list.
This is a deliberately simple icon for display at 24 to 32 pixels.
Draw the design on a strict 16 by 16 logical pixel grid.
Show that grid at a large integer scale with crisp square pixels.
Use a warm gold folder silhouette with its tab at the upper left.
Show it almost from the front, with only a one-pixel right-side depth cue.
Use one dark blue-gray outline, three gold tones, and one small cream highlight.
Use large connected color blocks.
Keep the shape broad and low.
Leave a two-pixel margin on the logical canvas.
Use a genuinely transparent background.
Do not include a label, count, text, music note, paper sheets, logo, or small decorative details.
Avoid smooth gradients, glow, shadow, dithering, and anti-aliasing.
This is an original icon, not a reduced photograph.

perspectiveChecks: Crane mast and rope remain vertical.
The cartridge moves along the rope axis.
Both folders keep the tab at the upper left.
